records.text: Jimmy Kimmel's monologue about Melania Trump's family was corrosive, deepened America's political sickness, and should not be broadcast into homes each evening.

appearances.snippet: His monologue about my family is not comedy. ... His words are corrosive and deepens the political sickness within America. Does she know who she's married to? ... People like Kimmel shouldn't have the opportunity to enter our homes each evening to spread hate.
